crop.name: Top-Down Blur (Ambient Canvas)
crop.foreground: Centered stream (6% horizontal crop, 1% vertical crop)

duration_standards.narrative_rule: Snaps to natural sentence boundaries without premature cuts. Dynamically captures complete topic and story transitions up to 175s (3-minute YouTube Shorts limit) for storytelling/rants.

thumbnail_generation.face_aware_placement: Never obscures streamer face; sits in center divider zone (Y:740-920) or upper safe zone

visual_hook_elements.attention_callout: Curved neon red/yellow arrow pointing directly to peak emotional reaction
visual_hook_elements.cinematic_gradient: Soft vertical alpha gradient backing behind text for 100% contrast against bright video backgrounds
visual_hook_elements.typography: Multi-Color 3D Impact Bold (Polar White + Electric Yellow with 14px black outline & drop shadow)
visual_hook_elements.reaction_pill_badge: YouTube Red (#E50914) rounded badge with crisp white outline & emoji callout

thumbnail_generation.climax_frame_scoring: YuNet DNN face tracking + facial emotion intensity variance (wide open mouth / screaming / surprise) + contrast
thumbnail_generation.psychological_curiosity_hooks: Terror, Rage, Instant Regret, Caught in 4K, Controversy, or Incomplete Story curiosity gaps

publishing_cadence.selection_rule: Highest calibrated virality score first, interleaving streamers to prevent audience fatigue.

storage_and_retention.eviction_strategy: Purge clips and database events older than 48 hours; purge rolling buffer chunks beyond window.

worker_1_stream_capture.responsibility: 24/7 concurrent parallel stream capture & rolling buffer management across all active streamers.

worker_2_ai_engine.responsibility: Audio transcription, multimodal CV + speech scoring, vertical 9:16 rendering in chosen format, dynamic subtitles, thumbnail creation.

worker_3_youtube_distribution.responsibility: Dedicated YouTube uploader adhering strictly to the 2-2-2 EST prime-time virality slots.
